intro_text: Three phases, one shared platform where it pays. Over-Ear ships first because TTM is shortest and ETL pre-approved PS paths exist. Core-like + Symphony share tooling and ship together. The Instrument lands as halo when the rest of the line is already in market and the Krell vacuum is still open.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Over-Ear Home Centric (fastest to market)
phases.rationale: **Fastest TTM in the line.** Hardware ~80% complete (refactor for aesthetic + control mods + 6-end-point charge QA). Software ~70% (l'Art algos + 6-end-point concurrent stream). Ships first to establish AGF in market, fund the rest of the line, and validate the channel.
milestones: V1 SKU ships with RF-default dock + BT 5.3 (SBC/AAC/aptX/aptX HD/LDAC)
Channel introductions to stranded Polk/Definitive/McIntosh independents
V2 refactor scoped — execution in 8–12 months ($120K tooling)

phases.title: Phase 2 — Core-like Small (shared platform)
phases.rationale: **Shared tooling.** Core-like small shares electronics platform with the soundbar. Three SKUs, one tooling investment.
milestones: Shared electronics platform freeze (l'Art module + power supply)

phases.title: Phase 2 — Core-like Soundbar (shared platform)
phases.rationale: **Shared tooling, mid-sandwich pricing.** Core-like soundbar shares the small unit's electronics platform.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Symphony Macro-System
phases.rationale: **Mid-sandwich pricing.** Symphony shares manufacturing partners and certification budget with Core-like. $2,990 retail with the $29,990 review-tier anchor.
milestones: Symphony **PR stunt: submitted for review at $29,990, corrected post-submission to $2,990**

phases.title: Phase 3 — The Instrument (flagship halo)
phases.rationale: **Halo product, halo timing.** Lands just above Focal's consumer flagship (~$5K) while Krell is still rebuilding dealer trust. Pro-tier UI empowers live-mixing techs to submit innovations (royalty-paid) — feeds Balcony installations at flagship venues.
milestones: Companion GaN mono-block + Gowin FPGA processor + transmission-line sub validated
Royalty-paid third-party innovation pipeline open through Balcony

phases.title: Phase 3 — Wasted Real-Estate (suppressed product return)
phases.rationale: **Suppressed Dolby concept returns.** Originally killed by Apple licensing threat — the backstory itself carries the launch. Paired with venue pilots to land 1,000 pcs/mo Year-1 globally across 100+ retail partners.

pr_stunts.name: Symphony Review-Tier Anchor
pr_stunts.description: **Symphony Macro-System submitted for review at $29,990**, then corrected post-submission to **$2,990 retail**. The press receives the unit at the prestige-audio price; the customer buys it at the mass-premium price. Anchors the perceived ceiling, then drops the ladder.
pr_stunts.timing: Phase 2 — submitted to long-lead reviewers ahead of retail availability

pr_stunts.name: Wasted Real-Estate Suppression Story
pr_stunts.description: Originally concepted at Dolby; Apple shut it down via licensing threat. The story itself is the launch — channel-probe-positive, vetted, the suppressed product returns. PR earns its keep with the backstory, not the spec sheet.
pr_stunts.timing: Phase 2–3 — paired with the Instrument launch for narrative density

venue_pilots.criteria: **First 5 financially qualifying markets.** Selection by (a) density of arts-aware sophisticated audio buyers, (b) local performing-arts ecosystem strength, (c) availability of an owner-operator partner willing to host the FoH/Balcony/Green Room blueprint. **One venue per market — never two.**
venue_pilots.notes: Pilots double as Phase 2/3 launch surfaces — l'Art Production line in the Balcony, full consumer line in the Green Room, virtual all-access pass bundled with hardware ownership.

year_one_targets.anchor_reference: **Wasted Real-Estate Y1 target: 1,000 pcs/month globally** with 100+ retail partners (100 pcs/mo across 2 PoC venues). Comparable: **Focal's flagship reference moves ~1,000 pcs/month** with a focused rep firm — the volume is real and reachable in Y1.
year_one_targets.notes: Y1 unit volume compounds across the line: Over-Ear (Phase 1) carries the run-rate, Core-like + Symphony (Phase 2) build margin, the Instrument (Phase 3) opens the halo — and Wasted Real-Estate validates the case-as-product thesis at 1,000 pcs/mo.
